description_en: Changes the switchover time of O\&M events
description_zh: 调用ModifyMaintenanceAction接口修改运维事件的执行时间
name: ModifyMaintenanceAction

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the pending O\&M event. You can specify multiple IDs to batch change the switchover time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271738.html operation to query the information about pending O\&M events, including the event ID.
You can change the switchover time only for pending O\&M events. The switchover time of historical O\&M events cannot be changed. For more information about the status of pending and historical O\&M events, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271738.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标待处理运维事件的ID。支持输入多个ID来批量修改切换时间，多个ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271738.html接口查看目标待处理运维事件的详情，包括ID。
仅待处理运维事件支持修改切换时间，历史运维事件不支持修改切换时间。关于待处理运维事件和历史运维事件的状态详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271738.html
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The point in time when you want the system to perform operations on the pending O\&M event. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 后台将在指定时间点执行目标待处理运维事件所对应的操作。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the pending O\&M event occurs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
目标待处理运维事件所在地域的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
